title: PAANI : On Device Visual Evidence Fusion and Explainable Guidance for River Robot Simulation
description:
arXiv:2609.22353v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Mobile river monitoring robots must interpret obstacles and water boundaries that geographic waypoints alone cannot describe. On resource constrained platforms, converting imperfect visual predictions into timely and inspectable guidance is a distinct challenge. An object label or steering command does not explain which evidence supports a decision or when that evidence is unreliable. We present PAANI, an on-device perception to guidance architect
